inshallah.translation: int. <阿拉伯>但凭天意, 听天由命,印沙安拉

insheathe.definition: v. t. To insert as in a sheath; to sheathe.
insheathe.translation: vt.把…插入鞘内,把…放入套中(亦作insheath)

insheathed.translation: [医] 包于鞘内的, 被包的

inshore.definition:
a. (of winds) coming from the sea toward the land
s. close to a shore
r. toward the shore
inshore.translation:
a. 近海岸的, 向陆的
adv. 近海岸, 向陆地
